vibes.name: Warm low-poly dusk
vibes.one_line: Chunky faceted hills, one lit window, the last of the sun.
vibes.look_words: A small faceted world at the end of the day. Olive and moss greens for the ground, terracotta and warm stone for rocks and walls, long violet shadows, a peach horizon under a deep blue sky. Shapes are chunky and flat-shaded, two tones per surface, no texture noise. One low warm sun does the work; amber is kept for lit windows, lanterns and the things to collect. Motion is slow: smoke, a swaying tree, drifting dust. Materials are matte, like painted wood and clay. Avoid glossy surfaces, bloom, neon, pure black and busy textures.

vibes.name: Paper diorama

vibes.look_words: A little world cut from coloured paper and stood up on a desk. Kraft-brown and sand paper for the ground, sage green and cream for hills and buildings, with pink and bright blue kept for the things that matter. Everything is a flat layer with a clean cut edge and a thin real shadow under it; depth comes from layers stacked front to back, not from detail. One warm lamp lights it from above, and the room behind is dark and soft. Motion is like a pop-up book: things slide, fold, tilt and swing on tabs. Avoid gradients, gloss, thin lines, realistic textures and anything that looks rendered rather than cut.

vibes.look_words: A desert on another world at sunset, painted like the cover of an old science-fiction paperback. Dunes in rust, maroon and ochre with smooth airbrushed fades; a burnt-orange sky with two small low suns and a huge pale ringed planet. Shadows are long and deep maroon. Shapes are bold and smooth with clean edges and very little detail. Because the whole world is red and orange, harm is a vivid violet, and the things that matter are bright yellow and teal; the player is cream. Motion is wind and speed: sand streaming off dune crests, long dust trails, sails filling. Avoid green, grey, gritty realism, lens flares, and bloom on the suns.

vibes.name: Gothic candlelight
vibes.one_line: Cold stone, tall arches and small pools of candle flame.
vibes.look_words: A great stone hall at night, lit by candles. Blue-grey and brown-black stone, dark wood, worn plum carpet, tall pointed arches that vanish into shadow. Light comes in small warm pools around candles and in cold blue shafts of moonlight from high windows, and most of the room is dark. Candle gold marks what to take and where to go, moonlight blue marks the goal, red is harm, and the player is pale so it shows in both lights. Shapes are tall, narrow and heavy. Motion is slight: flames leaning, dust in a shaft of light, a cloak moving. Sound echoes. Avoid gore, flat even lighting, coloured fog, crushed black where the player must walk, and bloom.

vibes.name: Ember and ash
vibes.one_line: Black rock, falling ash and one river of orange.
vibes.look_words: A volcanic land after the fire. Charcoal and soot-brown rock, grey ash on every ledge, dead black trees, a heavy red-brown sky. Lava is the only bright thing in the world and it means harm, so its orange is never used for anything else. Things to collect and the goal are cool: pale cyan and pale gold, the opposite of the fire. The player is pale grey, like ash-covered cloth, and reads against the black rock. Light is dim and comes from below, with warm bounce from the lava on the undersides of things. Shapes are jagged and cracked. Motion is slow and heavy: ash falling like snow, embers rising, lava creeping. Avoid red fog over everything, glow on rocks, purple, and bloom that washes out the lava.

vibes.name: Neon arcade (restrained)
vibes.one_line: Thin bright lines on dark indigo; light used sparingly.
vibes.look_words: An arcade look that keeps its light under control. Dark indigo surfaces with a slight gloss; thin crisp lines in magenta and cyan along edges, lanes and gates; a low skyline of plain dark blocks. Nine tenths of the screen stays dark so the lines stay sharp. The player is cyan, pickups are yellow, the goal is green, and magenta means harm. Shapes are simple geometry: triangles, grids, rings. Glow is small and tight around each line, never a haze over the picture. Motion is fast and clean: short light trails, quick flashes on hits, a pulsing grid in time with the music. Avoid heavy bloom, purple fog, lens flares, chrome, more than four bright colours and flashing that strains the eyes.
